design: 80 sessions (40 from Sonnet-5.5-authored shard tr04, 40 from Opus-authored train shards tr01-tr03), shuffled and anonymised, labelled blind by two independent annotator agents (40 each); disagreements adjudicated by one reader with the author hidden
